items.t: Rod knock and sudden engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $2,000-$5,000. A used 2003-2005 engine is the common fix.

items.t: Heavy oil consumption
items.job: Replace piston rings (engine rebuild) or engine
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,400-$3,000. A ring-cleaning treatment costs far less and sometimes helps.

items.t: Engine failure on early GT-S models
items.job: Replace GT-S engine with used unit

items.t: Worn or broken valve lift bolts
items.job: Replace lift bolts with updated part
items.note: The bolts cost about a dollar each; a valve cover gasket may add a little. Broken bolts take longer to extract.

items.t: Power loss or no lift above 6,000 rpm
items.job: Diagnose lift system and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gelling)
items.job: Engine sludge cleaning (pan off) or engine replacement
items.note: Cleaning is the low end; a seized engine needs replacement. Toyota's old coverage has ended.

items.t: Oil leak from the oil pump and front seals
items.job: Replace oil pump seals, front seals and timing belt

items.t: Ignition coil inside the distributor fails
items.job: Replace distributor ignition coil (or distributor)

items.t: Automatic transmission shifting poorly at high mileage
items.job: Replace throttle position sensor and service fluid
items.note: RepairPal lists $298-$396 for the sensor. If the transmission is worn inside, a replacement costs much more.

items.t: Power steering pump and hose leaks
items.job: Replace power steering pressure hose or pump

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver airbag inflator (recall 20V-033)

items.t: Add-on cruise control throttle linkage may stick (recall)
items.job: Repair cruise control throttle linkage (recall 96E-001)

items.t: Convertible top wearing where it rubs
items.job: Adjust top and repair or replace worn fabric
items.note: Patching is the low end; a new top is the high end.

items.t: Musty smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Clean and treat A/C evaporator

items.t: Crankshaft sensor code (P0335) from a weak battery
items.job: Test and replace 12V battery

items.t: Manual transmission bearing whine and failure
items.job: Rebuild manual transmission (input shaft bearing)
items.note: An owner reports $1,000-$2,000 for the bearing job and $4,000-$6,000 for a new transmission.

items.t: Clutch wearing out early
items.job: Replace clutch kit
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,494-$1,931 total. Flywheel work costs extra.

items.t: Transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace transmission with used or remanufactured unit

items.t: Automatic transmission fluid leak
items.job: Replace leaking transmission seal or gasket

items.t: Check engine light for variable valve timing (P1349)
items.job: Replace VVT oil control valve

items.t: Check engine light and rough running in freezing weather
items.job: Diagnose lean codes and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Check engine light for misfire codes
items.job: Replace spark plugs and ignition coil

items.t: Hard starting or rough idle after the battery is disconnected
items.job: Idle relearn and throttle body cleaning

items.t: Squeal or rattle when slowing down after a cold start
items.job: Diagnose noise and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Rear hatch won't stay up
items.job: Replace rear hatch struts (pair)

items.t: Water leaking into the interior
items.job: Water-leak test, reseal and dry carpet

items.t: Creak or tick from the windshield or rear glass
items.job: Inspect and service glass stoppers per Toyota bulletin

items.t: Creaking moon roof
items.job: Moon roof noise repair per bulletin

items.t: Loose outer door handle
items.job: Adjust or shim outer door handle

items.t: Fuel can spill at the pump from a loose check valve (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair fuel filler check valve (recall 03V-074)

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace master cylinder and booster as needed (recall 04V-455)

items.t: Daytime running lights too bright (recall)
items.job: Install DRL resistor (recall 04V-566)
